title: Certify the startup counterexample to both fluent role claims
description: Prove on the original landed Spring Security graph that the A-only selector returns zero for the exact reachable names and the manager decision whenever the JVM starts with a pipe separator. Check the guarded bytecode and replay both unguarded original entries with the public names and grant on pipe, default LF and CRLF launches, binding the classes and runtime.
expected: Two complete native failure implications and a physical active counterexample with selector 1. LF and CRLF give a grant on the same input.
